description: A chamber kept for the smallest goblins. Low hammocks, fur piles, broken toys, sticks, stones, and scattered tools create a chaotic but supervised space.

exits.description: a small door with a faded teddy bear painting, its colors long since bled to ghosts of themselves.

items.description: a wooden rocking horse with a faded red leather saddle. it rocks gently as you pass, though no one touched it. one of its painted eyes seems to follow you. the rockers creak rhythmically, slowly coming to a stop.
items.name: rocking_horse

items.description: a porcelain doll with cracked, vacant eyes that seem to stare directly through you. its dress is old-fashioned, lace-trimmed. one arm is broken, revealing the hollow porcelain interior. something is stuffed inside.
items.name: doll

items.description: a tiny scrap of paper that was hidden inside the broken doll: 'the skull is in the study. take it to mother's grave. she'll know what to do. — e.' the handwriting is a child's, but the message is clear.
items.name: hidden_note_doll

items.description: lead toy soldiers arranged in a battle formation around a tiny replica of a crystal skull, made from painted glass. the soldiers point their rifles at the tiny skull, as if trying to protect something from it.
items.name: toy_soldiers

items.description: a child's leather diary, the pages yellowed and crumbly. the recurring phrase, written over and over in different colors of ink: 'the skull watches. the skull waits. eleanor is lonely. she wants me to play with her but she's not real anymore. mother says don't go near the study. but the skull calls me at night.' the final entry: 'tonight she's going to show me how to fly.'
items.name: child_diary

items.description: a small music box with a dancing ballerina. when opened, it plays a haunting, beautiful lullaby. the tune is strangely soothing, and as it plays, the whispers in the walls seem to harmonize with it.
items.name: lullaby_box

items.description: a small wooden bed with a faded quilt patterned with stars and moons. the pillow is dented. the sheets are cold, but they smell faintly of lavender soap.
items.name: child_bed

name: Nursery
